hypothesis: Synchronous intraday cross-products improve next-day joint correlation estimation over the native30 simple-close estimator. This is different from predicting individual variances with HAR.
adaptation_not_replication: Realized covariance measurement follows Andersen et al 2003; the one-theta crypto correlation blend is our minimal adaptation. FX results do not establish crypto profitability.
data_role: Repeatedly seen 2021-2022 historical development. Earlier descriptive637-day source diagnosis already examined correlations through September2022. Neither diagnostic block is pristine unseen/OOS.
unknown: First source day RV boundary is NaN; complete mark December2021-September2022 and funding/arrival/venue/MMR certification unavailable. No trade-to-mark substitution or zero funding.
clock: Feature available at following UTCday00:00; no historical arrival certification. Forecast at t uses only completed source days <=t. Next-day label matures at t+1day.
native: np.cov(last30 daily SIMPLE close returns,rowvar=False,ddof=1). Preserve its variance diagonal and native annual365 risk scaling.
realized: R_realized30=correlation(sum last30 daily sum of synchronous5m log-return outer products); not mean of daily correlations.
candidate: R=(1-theta)R_native30+theta R_realized30; C=sqrt(D_native)R sqrt(D_native). Exactly one joint theta clipped[0,1], analytic least squares on mean10 next-day offdiagonal correlation errors, training only. No normalization fit, per-pair parameters, grid, optimizer, refit or adaptive windows.
longrun_definition: Normalize the sum of completed daily realized covariance rows underlying mature training labels only; fixed after fit.

prediction_gate.secondary: Report common long and fixed signed quadratic correlation losses; these do not rescue primary gate. No Gaussian return or profit inference.

bootstrap.sample_unit: one joint date, not five coins/ten pairs; no forecastESS from participation/Bartlett mean information

directions: Reuse public_cross_section_momentum.public_targets exact CORE5 21daily top/bottom2 weekly calendar/2024Jan1 anchor, short_confirmation=false, same available mask. Calendar anchor reads no2024 prices.
targets: BASE is exact native public_targets. JOINT applies additional single common min(1,.10/sigma_candidate) to BASE then calls unchanged signed_risk_weights on same past simple returns. No relever, relative-leg/direction change or capital increase. Model fixed after fit.
static_haircuts: Training-frozen mean JOINT/BASE scale and sqrt(trainingJOINT realized trade-path variance/trainingBASE variance), both <=1. Training in-sample sizing/calibration explicitly disclosed. Saved targets include both controls; all use same native recheck.

conditional_economic_gate.domain: Saved target fixed-weight5m TRADE log-return variance/adverse path proxies only. Not wallet, mark risk, fill, liquidation protection, netPnL or trading readiness.
conditional_economic_gate.terminal: Include target-to-zero turnover at each finite diagnostic end; no executable terminal liquidation claim.
conditional_economic_gate.cost_proxy: 0.00135*10000*absolute target turnover, shared hypothetical fee+slippage coefficient from prior conditional study; actual fees/slippage/funding UNKNOWN. No price-return netting/PnL claim.
conditional_economic_gate.equal_risk_interpretation: ES/sqrt(mean realized variance) is invariant to a constant proportional haircut; an ex-post normalization is solely an outcome diagnostic, never saved tradable targets or learnable oracle profit. Report actual risk and static train haircuts separately. Same target/caps is not equal actual risk.
conditional_economic_gate.if_fail: STOP_FIXED_JOINT_CORRELATION_BLEND; no wallet, alternate window, recipe rescue or posthoc refit

scope: Old HAR/upside-quantile/CPD/residual STOPs unchanged; locked body and2023/24 outcomes not read; separate distribution files unchanged. All models/results published with remote SHA and cold restore. No Library, credentials, account APIs, live/deployment/pay.
